keySentence: A frog popped up and offered to help her.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The frog was lonely. He wanted a friend. He offered to help. A frog popped up and offered to help her.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The frog had lived alone in the dark well for a long time. He was lonely and wished for a friend more than anything. A frog popped up and offered to help her get the ball. In return, he asked the princess to be his friend. The princess thought it was strange but she wanted her ball. She needed to make a decision right away.
facts.Word cards: princess = 공주 / golden = 황금색의 / dropped = 떨어뜨렸다 / well = 우물 / into = 안으로
